# SCAD AI IDE

> Independent open-source OpenSCAD development environment inside VS Code for humans and AI agents. Source-first development preview.

## Capabilities
- [Runtime management](https://peterisdev42.github.io/scad-ai-ide/#runtime-management): Discover, install and select OpenSCAD CLI versions from one workspace. Use an existing executable, an available build or a local archive; switch between installed versions without manually assembling a toolchain. Availability depends on platform and runtime build.
- [Library and dependency management](https://peterisdev42.github.io/scad-ai-ide/#library-management): Discover OpenSCAD libraries through SCAD Registry, select an exact version, and restore a project on another machine using its declaration and lockfile. A shared global store supports multiple versions and project-local mounts; OpenSCAD processes receive a project-scoped OPENSCADPATH. Exact versions only; no automatic recursive dependency solver. Copy fallback requires confirmation; some Windows non-ASCII paths remain a known CLI limitation.
- [OpenSCAD language support](https://peterisdev42.github.io/scad-ai-ide/#language-intelligence): Use familiar editor tooling for OpenSCAD source and project libraries with a language server integrated into VS Code. A compatible language server build is required.
- [Interactive 3D preview](https://peterisdev42.github.io/scad-ai-ide/#interactive-preview): Switch between source and the interactive Preview editor. Explore geometry in 3D, measure supported features and export the result using the selected OpenSCAD runtime. Operations vary with runtime and rendering mode. Fast CSG needs an additional Preview Exporter on supported macOS ARM64 setups; per-part coloring is experimental and visual-only.
- [Visual Customizer](https://peterisdev42.github.io/scad-ai-ide/#visual-customizer): Expose model parameters as visual controls. Adjust parameter overrides, preview changes and save OpenSCAD-compatible presets. Structured source analysis and guarded edits are available separately. Agent/model authoring acceptance is ongoing; continuous slider rendering depends on the supported backend.
- [Native VS Code experience](https://peterisdev42.github.io/scad-ai-ide/#native-gui): Use Quick Access, the Customizer sidebar, editor actions, Problems and the AI panel instead of juggling standalone tools. Interactive OpenSCAD code blocks in Markdown connect documentation and geometry. The website demo is a limited workbench, not the full desktop extension.
- [CAD verification and design review](https://peterisdev42.github.io/scad-ai-ide/#cad-verification): Inspect CLI-backed CSG diagnostics and raw meshes, measure frozen geometry, check declared static assembly constraints and compare reports. Preserve evidence and request surface-specific human feedback. PASS, FAIL and UNRESOLVED describe tested evidence only. Printability remains NOT_CHECKED; no manufacturing guarantee, motion-path or general mechanical proof.
- [Native AI Agent integration](https://peterisdev42.github.io/scad-ai-ide/#agent-integration): Supported VS Code Agent hosts can access the same bounded domain services as GUI actions. Native tools, skills and instructions connect environment setup, parameter editing, diagnostics, geometry evidence and design review. No bundled LLM or MCP server. Host/provider support, Workspace Trust, permissions and stale-state checks apply. Registered tools do not establish reliable autonomous-model acceptance.

The website demo uses geometry compiled from the actual cheese.scad source at build time, not a live browser compiler. llms.txt is optional and not a Google search ranking prerequisite.
